The AI Revolution in Enterprise Automation

AI enablement isn’t just about adding a new feature; it’s about creating a smarter, more proactive automation ecosystem. Automate troubleshooting: When a job fails, the AI assistant can analyze logs and reports, identify the problem, and even suggest potential fixes, drastically reducing mean time to repair.

The AI assistant in Automic instantly analyzes the logs from the failed execution, explains the reason for the failure in plain English, and suggests a code snippet to fix the issue. The IT team can resolve the problem in minutes, not hours.

sources.title: Automic Automation V26: Turning Orchestration Into the Control Center for Enterprise AI | AutomWorx
sources.content:
Automic Automation V26: Turning Orchestration Into the Control Center for Enterprise AI

What’s Actually Different Day-to-Day

AI Assistant, built on MCP. Automic’s AI layer connects to your models through the Model Context Protocol, acting as both client and server. Ask it what happened in last night’s run, and it parses logs, execution reports, and documentation to tell you not just what happened, but why root causes, upstream delays, similar fixes that worked before.

Bring your own LLM. On SaaS, a default model comes built in. On-prem, you connect Automic to whichever LLM provider you already use cloud-hosted or a local model. Same governance either way. The model changes; the control layer doesn’t.

AI-assisted scripting and workflow building. The AI Assistant explains, troubleshoots, and generates scripts on request, including converting a Python script to PowerShell on the spot. Natural-language workflow building is part of this too.

What This Means for Your Operation

At Automworx, we help teams evaluate, implement, and get real value out of Automic Automation V26, from migration to configuration for a live environment.

sources.content:
Fiserv Collaborates with Microsoft to Accelerate AI-Driven Innovation

January 8, 2026

Fiserv will deploy Microsoft 365 Copilot across its global workforce, equipping employees with access to advanced AI tools that enhance productivity, accelerate decision-making, and elevate the quality of work. In parallel, Fiserv is working with Microsoft to expand its use of Microsoft Foundry, an Azure-powered AI platform designed to build, customize, deploy, and manage AI applications safely and securely.

This expanded relationship with Microsoft builds on Fiserv’s existing use of Microsoft Foundry and deployment of Microsoft’s GitHub Copilot. To date, Fiserv has processed more than 100 billion tokens in Foundry, enhancing products, client servicing experiences, and its proprietary developer gateway.

Deepening Investment in AI

Across Fiserv, AI already powers fraud detection, risk management, and personalized engagement for financial institutions; enables smarter decisioning and higher authorization rates for merchants; and improves client servicing, compliance, and developer productivity.

Forward-Looking Statements

The factors that could cause Fiserv’s actual results to differ materially include, among others: Fiserv and Microsoft’s ability to successfully deploy and embed artificial intelligence solutions into its platforms and operations; exposure to liability as a result of any misuse of artificial intelligence by Fiserv’s personnel; the integration of third-party artificial intelligence models with our services relies on certain safeguards implemented by the third-party developers which may be insufficient; and other factors included in “Risks Factors” in Fiserv’s filings with the SEC.

sources.title: Artificial Intelligence | BNY
sources.content:
ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE AT BNY

For more than five years, BNY has been creating Artificial Intelligence (AI) enabled solutions for financial services – and we’re continuing to move fast to accelerate our AI journey. We are the first major bank to deploy an AI Supercomputer (powered by NVIDIA) to accelerate processing capacity and to launch AI enabled capabilities. We have over 125 AI-enabled solutions in production, as well as our own Enterprise AI platform.

Introducing Eliza

Our enterprise AI platform, Eliza, is built on the premise of foundational, reusable capabilities and is designed to enhance client service, company operations and drive cultural transformation through the power of artificial intelligence.

OpenAI, the company behind ChatGPT, has spotlighted BNY’s forward-thinking approach to deploying AI across the organization to increase efficiency and drive change.

AI AT WORK TODAY, EVOLVING FOR TOMORROW

We have over 125 AI-enabled solutions in production ⁠–⁠ from predictive analytics and automation to anomaly detection ⁠–⁠ designed to help clients transform their business while optimizing our own infrastructure.

sources.title: The Clearing House and the Bank Policy Institute Support Regulatory Proposal to Modernize Anti-Money Laundering Rules
sources.content:
The Clearing House and the Bank Policy Institute filed a letter supporting the Financial Crimes Enforcement Network’s (FinCEN) proposed changes to modernize the regulations implementing the Bank Secrecy Act which aims to prevent illicit finance.

The Associations also urge FinCEN to promote innovation and improve supervisory consistency by creating a formal framework that encourages the responsible use of technologies such as artificial intelligence, machine learning, digital identity tools, and blockchain analytics without exposing banks to additional supervisory risk.
